blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent geospatial foundation models have introduced a new paradigm for large-scale Earth observation by providing pretrained embedding representations that can be directly exploited for downstream tasks. In this work, we investigate the use of Google AlphaEarth Foundations embeddings for national-scale crop type mapping in Morocco. The proposed workflow operates directly on publicly available 64-dimensional pretrained embeddings using lightweight downstream classifiers, eliminating the need to process raw satellite imagery during model training and inference. The approach targets three crop categories, namely winter cereals, tree crops, and other crops. For nationwide inference, the Fields of the World global field boundary map is used to constrain predictions to agricultural parcels, enabling efficient large-scale mapping. Experimental evaluation on an independent test set over ten repeated runs achieved an average classification accuracy of (87.17 +/- 0.42%). Nationwide inference over Morocco was completed in approximately five hours, with the dominant computational cost arising from cloud-based retrieval of the embeddings rather than model execution. These results demonstrate the potential of pretrained embedding representations for computationally efficient national-scale crop type mapping.
blocks.zh: 最近的地理空间基础模型为大规模地球观测引入了一种新的范式,提供了经过预先培训的嵌入式表述,可直接用于下游任务。 在这项工作中,我们调查摩洛哥利用Google AlphaEarth基金会嵌入的作物类型绘图。 拟议的工作流程直接使用可公开使用的64维预先培训的嵌入器,使用轻量级下游分级器,从而无需在模型培训和推论期间处理原始卫星图像。 这种办法针对三种作物,即冬季谷物、树木作物和其他作物。 就全国而言,世界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地界地 对10次重复试验进行的实验评价平均分类精度(87.17+/-0.42%)。 在大约5个小时内完成了对摩洛哥的全国性推论,主要计算费用来自基于云的嵌入物检索,而不是模型执行。 这些结果表明,在计算高效的国家规模作物类型绘图方面,预先培训的嵌入表示具有潜力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Remote sensing has become an indispensable technology for large-scale Earth observation, enabling continuous monitoring of environmental, agricultural, and ecological systems. Among its numerous applications, crop type mapping plays a central role in precision agriculture, agricultural statistics, food security assessment, and land-use management. Compared with traditional field surveys, satellite remote sensing provides a cost-effective and scalable alternative for producing crop maps over large geographic regions. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and big-data analytics have further accelerated this transition, enabling increasingly accurate crop classification from multi-temporal satellite imagery [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 遥感已成为大规模地球观测不可或缺的技术,能够不断监测环境、农业和生态系统。 在其众多应用中,作物类型测绘在精准农业、农业统计、粮食安全评估和土地利用管理等方面发挥核心作用。 与传统的实地调查相比,卫星遥感为制作大地理区域的作物图提供了成本效益高和可扩展的替代办法。 人工智能,机器学习,大数据分析等近期的进步,进一步加快了这一过渡,使从多时卫星图像中得出的作物分类越来越准确 [1].

blocks.en: Despite these advances, developing reliable crop mapping models remains challenging in regions where annotated agricultural data are scarce. Many countries, particularly in the Global South, lack the extensive ground-truth datasets required to train modern deep learning models, resulting in limited generalization and reduced mapping accuracy. Collecting field observations at national scale is both time-consuming and financially expensive, creating a major bottleneck for operational crop monitoring systems.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但在缺乏附加说明的农业数据的地区,开发可靠的作物测绘模型仍然具有挑战性。 许多国家,特别是全球南方国家,缺乏培训现代深层学习模型所需的广泛的地面真象数据集,导致通用性有限,绘图准确度降低。 在全国范围内收集实地观测数据既费时又费钱,为可操作的作物监测系统制造了重大的瓶颈。

blocks.en: The emergence of geospatial foundation models offers a promising paradigm for addressing this limitation. Large-scale models such as TerraMind [ 6 ] , SpectralEarth-FM [ 2 ] , and related foundation models leverage self-supervised pretraining on massive volumes of Earth observation data to learn generic representations that can be transferred to downstream remote sensing tasks with minimal labeled data. These models have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of benchmarks, suggesting that pretrained representations can substantially reduce the dependence on extensive local annotations.
blocks.zh: 地理空间基础模型的出现为解决这一局限性提供了一个很有希望的范例。 TerraMind [6], Spectral Earth-FM [2]等大型模型,以及相关的地基模型,利用对大量地球观测数据进行自我监督的预训,来学习可被转移至下游遥感任务的通用表述,并使用最小的标注数据. 这些模式在各种基准方面表现良好,表明经过预先训练的表述可以大大减少对广泛地方说明的依赖。

blocks.en: More recently, a complementary paradigm has emerged through the use of precomputed embedding representations [ 4 ] . Instead of processing raw satellite imagery during downstream inference, foundation models encode multi-temporal and multimodal observations into compact, high-dimensional feature vectors that capture both spectral and temporal information. This approach significantly reduces computational requirements while preserving the information necessary for classification. The concept was first demonstrated on a global scale by the Presto foundation model [ 9 ] in the WorldCereal project and has since been further advanced by Google’s AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) embeddings [ 3 ] and the Tessera foundation modelc [ 5 ] . These embedding-based representations enable efficient large-scale analysis by replacing computationally intensive feature extraction with reusable latent representations. Recent studies have demonstrated that embedding-based workflows can not only improve classification performance but also substantially reduce storage, preprocessing, and inference costs, making national-scale mapping considerably more practical.
blocks.zh: 最近,通过使用预先计算的嵌入式表述[4],出现了一种互补的模式。 基础模型不是在下游推论期间处理原始卫星图像,而是将多时和多模式观测编码成紧凑的高维特征矢量,既能捕捉光谱信息,又能捕捉时间信息。 这种方法在保留分类所必要的信息的同时,大大减少了计算要求. 这一概念最早由世界谷物项目中的普雷斯多地基模型[9]在全球范围展示出,此后被谷歌的阿尔法地基嵌入[3]和泰塞拉地基模型c[5]所进一步推进. 这些基于嵌入的表示方式能够通过用可重复使用的潜在表示取代计算密集的特性提取来进行高效的大规模分析。 最近的研究表明,以嵌入为基础的工作流程不仅能改善分类业绩,而且能大大减少存储、预处理和推论费用,使国家规模的绘图工作更加切合实际。

blocks.en: The availability of global foundation models, together with increasingly accessible planetary-scale Earth observation datasets, opens new opportunities for operational crop mapping in data-scarce regions. Rather than training complex deep learning architectures from scratch, downstream classifiers can be trained directly on foundation model embeddings, enabling efficient deployment while requiring only a limited amount of local training data.
blocks.zh: 全球基础模型的提供,加上日益易于获取的行星规模地球观测数据集,为在数据稀缺区域进行作物实用制图开辟了新的机会。 下游分级人员可以直接接受基础模式嵌入式培训,而不是从零开始培训复杂的深层学习架构,从而能够高效地部署,同时只需要有限的当地培训数据。

blocks.en: In this context, this paper investigates the capability of AEF embeddings for large-scale crop type mapping across Morocco. Specifically, we evaluate the effectiveness of pretrained embedding representations for national-scale crop classification and demonstrate a computationally efficient workflow that substantially reduces the cost of feature extraction and model deployment while maintaining competitive mapping accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在这方面,本文件调查了摩洛哥全国大规模作物类型绘图的AEF嵌入能力。 具体地说,我们评价预先经过培训的植入表示对于国家规模作物分类的有效性,并展示出计算效率高的工作流程,大大减少地物提取和模型部署的成本,同时保持有竞争力的绘图准确性。

blocks.en: 2 Study Area
blocks.zh: 2个研究领域

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Study area showing the agricultural regions considered in this work and the distribution of the reference data used for model development and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图1:表明本工作所考虑的农业区域的研究领域和用于模型开发和评价的参考数据的分布情况。

blocks.en: The study covers the major agricultural regions of Morocco, including Souss-Massa, Marrakech-Safi, Béni Mellal-Khénifra, Casablanca-Settat, Rabat-Salé-Kénitra, and Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceïma (Figure 1 ). These regions encompass a broad range of agro-climatic conditions, agricultural systems, and cropping practices, making them representative of Morocco’s agricultural landscape. The geographical diversity of the study area provides a suitable benchmark for evaluating the robustness and generalization capability of foundation model embeddings for national-scale crop type mapping.
blocks.zh: 这项研究涉及摩洛哥的主要农业地区,包括索斯-马萨、马拉喀什-萨菲、贝尼·梅拉尔-克赫尼夫拉、卡萨布兰卡-塞塔、拉巴特-萨莱-凯尼特拉和坦格尔-泰图安-霍塞马(图1)。 这些地区包含广泛的农业气候条件、农业体系和耕作做法,使它们代表了摩洛哥的农业景观。 研究区的地域多样性为评估国家规模作物类型测绘基础模型嵌入的稳健性和通俗化能力提供了一个适当的基准。

blocks.en:
Ground-truth data were compiled from the publicly available Moroccan agricultural database, which provides field-level crop annotations across the selected regions [ 7 ] . To further evaluate the generalization capability of the proposed workflow, an independent validation dataset was assembled using reference data collected during the 2025 agricultural season together with field observations acquired in the Tensift region between 2018 and 2024.
The complete reference dataset contains 13,844 agricultural polygons distributed among three crop classes: winter cereals, tree crops, and other crops. Figure 1 illustrates the geographical distribution of the study regions and the corresponding ground-truth data.
blocks.zh:
地面真实数据是从可公开获取的摩洛哥农业数据库中汇编而来,该数据库提供选定区域的实地作物说明[7]。 为了进一步评价拟议工作流程的总体化能力,利用2025年农业季节收集的参考数据以及2018年至2024年在Tensift地区获得的实地观测数据,收集了一个独立的验证数据集。
完整的参考数据集包含13,844个农业多边形,分布在三种作物类别:冬季谷物、树木作物和其他作物。 图1说明了研究区域的地理分布和相应的地面真实数据。

blocks.en: 3 Remote Sensing Data
blocks.zh: 3 遥感数据

blocks.en: This study relies exclusively on the Google AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) embedding dataset [ 3 ] . The AEF is a geospatial foundation model that learns compact latent representations from large volumes of multi-temporal and multimodal satellite observations through self-supervised learning. Instead of operating directly on raw satellite imagery, the model encodes each observation into a fixed-length embedding vector that captures its spectral, temporal, and contextual characteristics, allowing the learned representations to be transferred efficiently to downstream Earth observation tasks.
blocks.zh: 本研究完全依靠Google AlphaEarth基金会(AEF)嵌入数据集[3]. AEF是一个地理空间基础模型,通过自我监督的学习,从大量多时段和多模式卫星观测中学习紧凑的潜在表现。 该模型不是直接在原始卫星图像上运行,而是将每次观测编码成固定长的嵌入向量,能够捕捉其光谱、时间和背景特征,从而使所学到的表示能被高效地转移到下游地球观测任务上。

blocks.en: The publicly available AEF embeddings, distributed through an open AWS S3 bucket, are provided at a spatial resolution of 10 m. Each observation is represented by a 64-dimensional quantized embedding vector, which is dequantized prior to model training. Throughout this work, these embeddings constitute the only input features used for crop classification.
blocks.zh: 公开使用的AEF嵌入器通过开放的AWS S3水桶进行分配,其空间分辨率为10米. 每次观测都由64维的四分法嵌入向量来代表,在模型训练前被分解. 在整个这项工作中,这些嵌入物构成作物分类的唯一输入特征。

blocks.en:
The proposed workflow aims to classify agricultural observations into three general crop categories: winter cereals, tree crops (arboriculture), and other crops.
To facilitate nationwide crop mapping, the Fields of the World (FTW) global field boundary map [ 8 ] is employed during inference. The FTW parcel layer is used as a spatial mask restricting inference to agricultural areas, thereby avoiding predictions over non-agricultural land cover. For every agricultural parcel, the corresponding AEF embedding is retrieved and classified into one of the three target crop categories. This strategy substantially reduces the computational cost of nationwide inference while preserving complete coverage of cultivated land. Although the FTW map may require local refinement, it provides an excellent starting point for large-scale operational crop mapping at a fraction of the computational cost.
blocks.zh:
拟议的工作流程旨在将农业观测分为三大类作物:冬季谷物、树木作物(农业)和其他作物。
为了便利全国作物测绘,在推论中采用了世界田地(FTW)全球田地边界地图[8]. FTW地块地层被用作空间遮罩,将推论限制在农业地区,从而避免了对非农业用地覆盖的预测. 对于每个农业地块,对应的AEF嵌入被取回并归类为三个目标作物类别之一. 该战略大大减少了全国推断的计算成本,同时保留了耕地的完整覆盖。 尽管FTW地图可能需要局部改进,但它为以计算成本的一小部分进行大规模可操作作物绘图提供了一个极好的起点.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Overview of the proposed workflow. Publicly available AEF embeddings are first dequantized and combined with ground-truth reference polygons to construct the training dataset. Lightweight downstream classifiers are then trained and evaluated on an independent test set. During nationwide inference, the selected classifier is applied to the AEF embeddings within the Fields of the World field boundary map to produce the final nationwide crop type map.
blocks.zh: 图2:拟议工作流程概览。 公用AEF嵌入物首先被分解并结合地-地参考多边形来构建培训数据集. 轻量级下游分类人员随后在独立的测试集中接受培训和评价。 在全国范围推论期间,选定的分类器适用于在世界实地边界地段地图内嵌入的AEF,以制作最后的全国作物类型地图。

blocks.en: 4 Training and Inference Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 培训和推论方法

blocks.en: The complete workflow adopted in this study is illustrated in Figure 2 . The proposed methodology consists of four main stages: embedding preprocessing, training dataset generation, downstream model training and evaluation, and national-scale crop mapping.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了本研究所采用的全部工作流程。 拟议方法由四个主要阶段组成:嵌入预处理、培训数据集生成、下游模式培训和评价以及全国范围的作物测绘。

blocks.en: 4.1 Embedding Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.1 嵌入预处理

blocks.en: Following dequantization, every sample is represented by a 64-dimensional embedding vector with values approximately ranging from − 0.4764 -0.4764 to 0.4764 0.4764 .
blocks.zh: 分解后,每个样本都由64维嵌入向量代表,其值大约从−0.4764-0.4764到0.47640.4764.

blocks.en: 4.2 Training Dataset Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训数据集生成

blocks.en: Reference crop polygons were spatially overlaid with the AEF embedding dataset in order to associate each labeled observation with its corresponding embedding vector. For every reference sample, the extracted information includes the embedding vector, crop label, acquisition year, and additional metadata used during model development.
blocks.zh: 参考作物多边形用AEF嵌入数据集进行空间覆盖,以便将每个被标记的观测与其相应的嵌入向量联系起来。 对于每个参考样本,所提取的信息包括嵌入向量,作物标签,获取年份,以及模型开发过程中使用的额外元数据.

blocks.en: After preprocessing, the final training pool contains 71,062 labeled samples distributed among the three crop classes. This increase relative to the number of reference polygons results from sampling multiple embedding pixels within individual agricultural polygons. An additional independent test dataset containing 34,565 samples was isolated prior to model development and remained completely untouched during training, model selection, and hyperparameter optimization.
blocks.zh: 经过预处理后,最后培训池内有71,062个标有标签的样品,分布在三个作物班。 相对于参考多边形的数量而言,这一增长是由于在单个农业多边形内对多个嵌入像素进行了取样. 另一套包含34,565个样本的独立测试数据集在模型开发前被隔离,在培训、模型选择和超参数优化期间仍然完全没有受到影响。

blocks.en: 4.3 Model Training and Spatial Validation
blocks.zh: 4.3 示范培训和空间验证

blocks.en: The proposed workflow adopts an embedding-based downstream classification paradigm.
blocks.zh: 拟议的工作流程采用嵌入式下游分类范式。

blocks.en: Four downstream classifiers are evaluated throughout this study:
blocks.zh: 在整个研究中,对四个下游分类法进行了评价:

blocks.en: • Linear Probe; • Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP); • Random Forest; • Support Vector Machine (SVM).
blocks.zh: • 线性探测器;

blocks.en: Linear Probe;
blocks.zh: 线性探测器;

blocks.en: Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP);
blocks.zh: 多层受体(MLP);

blocks.en: Random Forest;
blocks.zh: 随机森林;

blocks.en: Support Vector Machine (SVM).
blocks.zh: 支持矢量机(SVM).

blocks.en: To obtain a robust estimate of model performance, each classifier is trained and evaluated over ten independent random seeds. The best-performing classifier is subsequently evaluated on the frozen independent test dataset, which was isolated prior to model development and remained completely untouched throughout training and hyperparameter optimization, in order to assess transferability to previously unseen geographical regions.
blocks.zh: 为了获得模型性能的可靠估计,每个分类员都要经过10个独立随机种子的培训和评价. 最佳的分类器随后在被冻结的独立测试数据集上得到评价,该数据集在模型开发前就被隔离,在培训和超参数优化过程中始终没有被完全改变,以便评估向先前未见的地理区域的可转移性。

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : Examples of the national crop type map produced using the proposed workflow. (On the left) Agricultural landscape in the Gharb region. (On the right) Agricultural landscape in the El Hajeb region.
blocks.zh: 图3:使用拟议工作流程制作的国家作物类型图实例。 (左)嘎布地区农业地貌. (右)埃尔哈杰布地区农业地貌.

blocks.en: 4.4 National-Scale Inference
blocks.zh: 4.4 国家规模推论

blocks.en: Following model selection, the best-performing classifier is deployed to generate a national crop type map over Morocco.
blocks.zh: 根据模型选择,部署最佳的分类器,以绘制摩洛哥全国作物类型图。

blocks.en: Instead of performing exhaustive pixel-wise prediction across the entire country, inference is restricted to agricultural parcels extracted from the 2024 Fields of the World (FTW) dataset. For each agricultural parcel, the corresponding AEF embedding is retrieved and processed by the trained classifier to predict one of the three target crop classes.
blocks.zh: 推论没有在全国进行详尽无遗的像素类预测,而是局限于从世界2024田地(FTW)数据集中提取的农业地块. 对每个农业地块,相应的AEF嵌入物由经过训练的分类员取回并处理,以预测三个目标作物类别中的一个.

blocks.en: This parcel-guided inference strategy significantly reduces computational requirements while enabling efficient nationwide crop mapping using only pretrained embedding representations. Figure 2 summarizes the complete processing pipeline from AEF embeddings to the final crop type map.
blocks.zh: 这一由包裹指导的推论战略大大减少了计算要求,同时能够仅使用经过预先培训的嵌入表示,在全国范围内进行有效的作物绘图。 图2概述了从AEF嵌入到最终作物类型图的完整加工管道。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Classification Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 分类业绩

blocks.en: The classification performance of the four evaluated downstream models on the independent test set is summarized in Table 1 . Each model was trained and evaluated over ten independent random seeds; the reported accuracy corresponds to the mean and standard deviation computed across runs.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了四个经评估的下游模型在独立测试组上的分类性能。 每个模型都经过了培训并评估了10个独立的随机种子;报告的准确性与所计算的不同阶段的平均和标准的偏差相符。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Test accuracy (%) on the independent test set for each downstream classifier (mean ± \pm standard deviation over 10 runs).
blocks.zh: 表1:每个下游分类器的独立测试集上的测试精度(%)(10个运行以上的平均±\pm标准差).

blocks.en: The results demonstrate that AEF contain highly discriminative information for agricultural crop classification. Despite relying exclusively on lightweight downstream classifiers, the learned representations achieve competitive and consistent performance across the three target crop categories. The MLP achieves the highest test accuracy at ( 87.17 ± 0.42 ) % (87.17\pm 0.42)\% , closely followed by Random Forest at ( 86.88 ± 0.08 ) % (86.88\pm 0.08)\% and Linear Probe at ( 86.66 ± 0.04 ) % (86.66\pm 0.04)\% . All models yield test accuracies in the range of 86 86 – 87 % 87\% on the independent test set, which consists exclusively of samples from regions excluded from model development, confirming the transferability of the AEF embeddings to previously unseen agricultural areas. Furthermore, the relatively small performance differences between the evaluated classifiers indicate that the pretrained embeddings already provide highly discriminative representations.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,农业作物分类中含有高度歧视性的信息。 尽管完全依靠轻量级下游分类人员,但学到的表述在三个目标作物类别中取得了有竞争力和一致的业绩。 MLP的测试精度最高,为(87.17±0.42)%(87.17\pm 0.42)%,紧随其后的是(86.88±0.08)%(86.88\pm 0.08)%(86.88\pm 0.08)%和线性探测(86.66± 0.04)%(86.66\pm 0.04)%. 所有模型在独立测试集的产量测试速率范围为86 86 — — 87 % — — 87 % — — — 完全由来自被排除在模型开发之外的地区的样本组成,这证实了AEF嵌入式可移植到先前未见的农业地区。 此外,受评价的分类人员之间的业绩差异相对较小,这表明预先培训的嵌入已经提供了高度歧视性的表述。

blocks.en: 5.2 National-Scale Crop Mapping
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家规模作物测绘

blocks.en: The selected MLP classifier is subsequently applied to the complete 2024 Fields of the World agricultural parcel layer to generate a national crop type map of Morocco. Nationwide inference was completed in approximately five hours, with the dominant computational cost arising from cloud-based retrieval of the AEF embeddings rather than model execution itself. This result highlights the practical scalability of the proposed embedding-based approach for operational crop monitoring at national scale.
blocks.zh: 所选的MLP分级器随后被应用到完整的"世界农业地块地层"2024田地上,生成摩洛哥国家作物类型地图. 全国的推论大约在5个小时内完成,主要计算费用来自基于云的AEF嵌入物检索,而不是模型执行本身。 这一结果突出表明了拟议的基于嵌入方式在国家一级开展作物业务监测的实际可扩展性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented a computationally efficient workflow for national-scale crop type mapping in Morocco using Google AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) pretrained embeddings. By operating exclusively on publicly available 64-dimensional embedding representations and lightweight downstream classifiers, the proposed approach eliminates the need for raw satellite imagery processing during both training and inference, substantially reducing the computational burden associated with large-scale crop mapping.
blocks.zh: 本文利用Google AlphaEarth基金会(AEF)预先培训的嵌入技术,介绍了摩洛哥国家规模作物类型绘图的计算效率工作流程。 通过专门使用公开的64维嵌入式表示和轻量级下游分级器,拟议办法消除了在培训和推论期间对原始卫星图像处理的需要,大大减少了与大规模作物测绘有关的计算负担。

blocks.en: Experimental results on an independent test set demonstrated that the MLP classifier achieves the best performance, with a test accuracy of ( 87.17 ± 0.42 ) % (87.17\pm 0.42)\% over ten random seeds, confirming the spatial transferability of the AEF embeddings to previously unseen agricultural regions. Nationwide inference over Morocco, guided by the Fields of the World field boundary map, was completed in approximately five hours, with cloud-based embedding retrieval identified as the dominant computational bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 独立测试集的实验结果显示,MLP分级器在10个随机种子上达到最佳性能,测试精度为(87.17±0.42)%(87.17\pm0.42)%,证实了AEF嵌入到之前未见的农业区域的空间可转移性. 在《世界实地边界地图实地》的指导下,摩洛哥全国范围的推论在大约5小时内完成,以云为基础的嵌入检索被确定为主要的计算瓶颈。

blocks.en: These findings demonstrate that foundation model embeddings offer a viable and scalable solution for crop type mapping in data-scarce regions, where collecting extensive ground-truth annotations is impractical. The combination of globally pretrained representations with the FTW agricultural parcel layer provides a powerful and cost-effective framework for operational crop monitoring at a national scale.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,嵌入基础模型为数据匮乏区域的作物类型绘图提供了一个可行和可扩展的解决办法,收集广泛的地表真实说明是不切实际的。 全球预先培训的表述与FTW农业地块层相结合,为在全国范围开展作物业务监测提供了一个强大而有成本效益的框架。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on incorporating additional crop categories, evaluating the generalization of the workflow across different agro-climatic contexts, and exploring multi-temporal embedding aggregation strategies to further improve classification accuracy.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于纳入其他作物类别,评价不同农业气候背景下工作流程的概况,并探索多时嵌入汇总战略以进一步提高分类准确性。
